verses.zh: 我儿，你若为朋友作保，替外人击掌，
verses.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.en: My son, if you have promised to pay a friend's debt, or shaken hands on a stranger's loan,

verses.zh: 你就被口中的话语缠住，被嘴里的言语捉住。
verses.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.en: then you are caught by your own words, trapped by what your own mouth said.

verses.zh: 我儿，你既落在朋友手中，就当这样行才可救自己：你要自卑，去恳求你的朋友。
verses.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.en: So do this, my son, and get yourself free: you are in your friend's hands, so go, humble yourself, and beg him to let you off.

verses.zh: 不要容你的眼睛睡觉；不要容你的眼皮打盹。
verses.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.en: Do not let your eyes sleep, or your eyelids close.

verses.zh: 要救自己，如鹿脱离猎户的手，如鸟脱离捕鸟人的手。
verses.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.en: Get free like a deer escaping the hunter, like a bird escaping the bird-catcher.

verses.zh: 懒惰人哪，你去察看蚂蚁的动作就可得智慧。
verses.kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.en: You lazy person, go and watch an ant. Look at what it does, and learn to be wise.

verses.zh: 蚂蚁没有元帅，没有官长，没有君王，
verses.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.en: An ant has no leader, no boss, and no king,

verses.zh: 尚且在夏天预备食物，在收割时聚敛粮食。
verses.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.en: yet it stores up its food in summer and gathers its meals at harvest time.

verses.zh: 懒惰人哪，你要睡到几时呢？你何时睡醒呢？
verses.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.en: You lazy person, how long will you lie there? When will you get up from your sleep?

verses.zh: 再睡片时，打盹片时，抱着手躺卧片时，
verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.en: A little more sleep, a little more dozing, a little more folding your hands to rest —

verses.zh: 你的贫穷就必如强盗速来，你的缺乏仿佛拿兵器的人来到。
verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.en: and being poor will come at you like a robber, and going without like an armed man.

verses.zh: 无赖的恶徒，行动就用乖僻的口，
verses.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.en: A good-for-nothing troublemaker goes around with a crooked mouth.

verses.zh: 用眼传神，用脚示意，用指点划，
verses.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.en: He winks his eyes, shuffles his feet, and points his fingers to signal others.

verses.zh: 心中乖僻，常设恶谋，布散纷争。
verses.kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.en: His heart is twisted; he is always planning trouble and starting fights.

verses.zh: 所以，灾难必忽然临到他身；他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
verses.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.en: So disaster will hit him suddenly; in a moment he will be broken, past mending.

verses.zh: 耶和华所恨恶的有六样，连他心所憎恶的共有七样：
verses.kjv: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
verses.en: There are six things the LORD hates, seven that he cannot stand:

verses.zh: 就是高傲的眼，撒谎的舌，流无辜人血的手，
verses.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.en: proud eyes, a lying tongue, hands that hurt innocent people,

verses.zh: 图谋恶计的心，飞跑行恶的脚，
verses.kjv: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.en: a heart that plans wicked things, feet that run quickly to do wrong,

verses.zh: 吐谎言的假见证，并弟兄中布散纷争的人。
verses.kjv: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.en: a false witness who tells lies, and anyone who stirs up fights between brothers.

verses.zh: 我儿，要谨守你父亲的诫命；不可离弃你母亲的法则，
verses.kjv: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.en: My son, keep your father's command, and do not turn away from your mother's teaching.

verses.zh: 要常系在你心上，挂在你项上。
verses.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
verses.en: Tie them onto your heart always; hang them around your neck.

verses.zh: 你行走，它必引导你；你躺卧，它必保守你；你睡醒，它必与你谈论。
verses.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.en: When you walk, they will lead you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you wake, they will talk with you.

verses.zh: 因为诫命是灯，法则是光，训诲的责备是生命的道，
verses.kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.en: A command is a lamp, teaching is a light, and being corrected is the road to life.

verses.zh: 能保你远离恶妇，远离外女谄媚的舌头。
verses.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.en: They will keep you away from a bad woman and from her smooth, flattering words.

verses.zh: 你心中不要恋慕她的美色，也不要被她眼皮勾引。
verses.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.en: Do not long for her beauty in your heart, or let her looks catch you.

verses.zh: 因为，妓女能使人只剩一块饼；淫妇猎取人宝贵的生命。
verses.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.en: Chasing that kind of woman can cost you everything you have, and even your life.

verses.zh: 人若怀里搋火，衣服岂能不烧呢？
verses.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.en: Can a man scoop fire into his shirt without burning his clothes?

verses.zh: 人若在火炭上走，脚岂能不烫呢？
verses.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.en: Can someone walk on hot coals without burning his feet?

verses.zh: 亲近邻舍之妻的，也是如此；凡挨近她的，不免受罚。
verses.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.en: It is the same for anyone who goes after his neighbour's wife: nobody who touches her gets off free.

verses.zh: 贼因饥饿偷窃充饥，人不藐视他，
verses.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.en: People do not look down on a thief who steals because he is starving,

verses.zh: 若被找着，他必赔还七倍，必将家中所有的尽都偿还。
verses.kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.en: but if he is caught, he must pay back seven times, even everything in his house.

verses.zh: 与妇人行淫的，便是无知；行这事的，必丧掉生命。
verses.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.en: Anyone who breaks a marriage has no sense at all; he destroys his own life doing it.

verses.zh: 他必受伤损，必被凌辱；他的羞耻不得涂抹。
verses.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.en: He will get wounds and shame, and the disgrace will never be wiped away,

verses.zh: 因为人的嫉恨成了烈怒，报仇的时候决不留情。
verses.kjv: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.en: because a jealous husband becomes furious, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

verses.zh: 什么赎价，他都不顾；你虽送许多礼物，他也不肯干休。
verses.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.en: He will not accept any payment, and no amount of gifts will calm him down.
